# Bexley Road pilots alone and the other three terminals wait for its numbers

## Decision Question

Does Dockside go live at one terminal first, or at all four together on the same build?

## Decision Outcome

Bexley Road runs the pilot by itself. Fairview, Colwick, and the Airport City yard are sequenced behind its first full month of appointment data, and nothing gets scheduled for them until that month closes.

## Alternatives Considered

- Stand all four up together, which Marguerite Ilves put forward on cost: one mobilisation, one training run, one set of interfaces to cut over.
- Pair Bexley with Fairview so the pilot covers both a cross-dock and a storage yard, which Iris Vogel treated as the same objection with a smaller number attached.

## Approved By

Iris Vogel, at the 2026-03-18 steerco, with Portside Systems noting the cost impact and not contesting it.

## Context

Iris's reason was diagnostic rather than financial: four terminals produce four explanations for the same bad week, and the pilot exists to make one week legible. Reversible in the sense that the other three can be pulled forward at any point; nothing structural depends on the sequence.
